sloka: अपूर्वी भार्यया च अर्थी तरुणः प्रिय दर्शनः ।अनुरूपः च ते भर्ता रूपस्य अस्य भविष्यति ॥३-१८-४॥
transliteration: apūrvī bhāryayā ca arthī taruṇaḥ priya darśanaḥ ।anurūpaḥ ca te bhartā rūpasya asya bhaviṣyati ॥3-18-4॥

translations.english: He is not with his wife, and is in need of one. He is young, handsome and worthy. He will be an appropriate husband to you.
